// GIVEN. The conversation on level 3. Do not edit. Yours is my/dialogue.txt, and it uses the same format.

NAME Ghost
BOSS Warden
QUEST boss
START 0 3 4 7

LINE 0
SAY The Warden locked me in here. While it lives, the door stays shut.
A I will deal with it. -> 1
B How do I beat it? -> 2

LINE 1
SAY Then go. Come back when it is over.
NEXT -1
GIVES start quest

LINE 2
SAY Hurt it from far away while you can. When it roars, the floor will hurt all of you.
A I will deal with it. -> 1
B Maybe later. -> -1

LINE 3
SAY It still lives. I can hear it.
NEXT -1

LINE 4
SAY It is gone. I can feel it. Let me help you, before I go.
NEXT 5
GIVES finish quest

LINE 5
SAY Be well.
NEXT 6
GIVES heal party

LINE 6
SAY And be ready.
NEXT -1
GIVES restore mana

LINE 7
SAY ...
NEXT -1
